validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false()"/>
    <data id="user"><name xmlns="">bob</name></data>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" cond="In(b)" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `In(b)` passes `b` unquoted, not the state ID `'b'`
notes: in XPath, `b` is a relative path from `<datamodel>` that selects no node, so `In()` receives the empty string; `In()` takes the state ID as a string
